component.name: Driver Manager
component.summary: Drivers and firmware for your hardware

description.p: The SDE Driver Manager finds hardware that needs drivers or firmware which are not free software: NVIDIA, AMD and Intel graphics, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth adapters whose firmware failed to load, and processor microcode. It recommends Debian's packages and installs them with the administrator's permission.
When the non-free-firmware, contrib or non-free components are missing from the APT sources it offers to add them, keeping a copy of the previous file.
Developed by the DebION Dev-Team for the Selviana Desktop Environment.
